prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1291; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed rear-end collision in a parking lot, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and occasional headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Cervical range of motion was restricted in flexion and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild spasm noted on examination. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry.

Over the course of 17 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted cervical mobilization, therapeutic exercise for deep neck flexor and scapular strengthening, and home stretching instruction. Modalities including heat and intermittent cold were used for symptom control during the early phase. Pain intensity and functional limitations were tracked at each visit using a standardized neck disability questionnaire.

By the final visit, the patient reported substantial improvement in pain and headache frequency, near-full cervical range of motion, and a return to usual daily activities and work duties. Residual mild stiffness with prolonged computer use persists, and a self-directed exercise program was recommended. Discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
